title: Term, Notice, Insurance and Outside Vendor Figures — Private Event & Banquet Services
content:
An event services agreement under Private Event & Banquet Services runs for the term printed against its package, ends on the notice printed against it, and carries the insurance condition and outside vendor fee printed against the same package.

| Package | Standard initial term, whole months | Notice to end the agreement, calendar days | Certificate of event insurance required before the event | Outside caterer or florist fee, per cent of that vendor's invoice |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 12 | 30 | No | 0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 12 | 30 | No | 0 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 12 | 45 | Yes | 5 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 24 | 60 | Yes | 8 |
| Gala Reception Package | 24 | 90 | Yes | 12 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 36 | 90 | Yes | 10 |

The term column is the standard initial term of the event services agreement in whole months and the notice column the calendar days of notice required to end it. The insurance column states whether a certificate of event insurance is required before the event. The last column is the fee charged when the client brings an outside caterer or florist into the venue, as a percentage of that vendor's invoice.

## Distinctions worth holding

Term and notice do not move together at every step. The Conference Day Delegate Package still runs a 12-month term but already requires 45 days of notice, where the two packages below it require 30; the Gala Reception Package and the Multi-Day Conference Residency Package both require 90 days although their terms are 24 and 36 months.

The insurance condition and the outside vendor fee begin at the same point on the schedule: both the Meeting Room Refreshment Package and the Boardroom Reception Package require no certificate and print a fee of 0, and every package from the Conference Day Delegate Package upward requires a certificate and prints a fee, the largest being 12 per cent on the Gala Reception Package.
